name: Agent Skills Hub (agentskillshub.top)
summary: Open-source directory of 276,000+ AI agent skills and MCP servers synced from GitHub every 8 hours, with 138,000+ entries security-graded across 43 static rules.
description:
An open-source, MIT-licensed searchable catalog and pre-install security grading index for AI agent skills (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI) and MCP servers.

- **Coverage**: 276,000+ indexed repositories synced from GitHub every 8 hours.
- **Security grading**: 138,000+ entries graded (`Safe`, `Caution`, `Unsafe`, `Reject`, `Unaudited`) against 43 published static rules documented at [agentskillshub.top/how-we-grade/](https://agentskillshub.top/how-we-grade/).
- **Pre-install analyzer & open data**: Free GitHub repository URL scanner at [agentskillshub.top/analyzer/](https://agentskillshub.top/analyzer/), scenario benchmarks at `/best/`, and an open CC BY 4.0 security audit dataset archived on CERN Zenodo (`DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21292799`).

*(Independent project at `agentskillshub.top`, distinct from `agentskillshub.dev`.)*

agent_access.notes: Also publishes a full machine-readable overview at https://agentskillshub.top/llms-full.txt and an npm MCP package (@agentskillshub/mcp).
